notes: The supplied and between φέρετε and θύσατε is added under rules 5 and 98: the Greek coordinates two imperatives asyndetically and both are rendered alike, so no source token carries the coordination. Rule 88 does not reach it, being scoped to a circumstantial participle converted into a coordinate clause — which is what licenses the second and, on εὐφρανθῶμεν.
